session_summary: As the Combat Challenger, I reviewed the play trace on Frostfang Pass (Difficulty 3). The run featured a total of only two combat encounters (Slime and Kobold) interspersed with walking and jumping over ice spikes, finishing with 100 HP and +25 coins. Despite Frostfang Pass having a high difficulty rating, the sparseness of encounters offers very little pressure, tactical depth, or risk/reward tension.

observations.evidence: In a 12-step high-difficulty route (Frostfang Pass, difficulty 3), only 2 enemy encounters occurred (Slime at step 2, Kobold at step 11), with 9 steps dedicated entirely to basic movement and obstacle jumps.
observations.recommendation: Increase enemy spawn frequency and introduce tighter spacing between encounters on difficulty 3+ routes to sustain combat momentum.

observations.evidence: The route reward yielded 25 coins for completing a tier-3 frost route with zero damage taken (100 HP final).
observations.recommendation: Scale completion coin rewards or bonus drops based on player remaining HP or flawless combat execution to reward mastery.

feature_requests.title: Elite Combat Waves & Aggressive Enemy Behaviors
feature_requests.player_value: Delivers satisfying tactical challenge, tests mechanical mastery, and justifies the high difficulty rating of tier-3 routes.
feature_requests.rationale: Current high-difficulty routes lack sufficient enemy friction, making combat feel like an afterthought rather than a core pillar of mastery.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Request engine support for elite enemy profiles and multi-wave encounter triggers on difficulty 3+ routes.

feature_requests.title: Combat Mastery Modifiers (Flawless Bonus)
feature_requests.player_value: Provides high-risk, high-reward incentives for players who excel at dodging and fighting without taking damage.
feature_requests.rationale: Rewarding clean combat execution directly aligns with the challenge-and-mastery player persona.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add a content modifier that grants bonus coin multipliers or rare crafting materials when completing routes with 100% HP.

keep: Clean separation of movement and enemy encounter steps in the telemetry trace.
The thematic alignment of Frostfang Pass hazards (ice spikes).
focus: encounter pacing, enemy friction, risk/reward, challenge and mastery
